name: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead
summary: A librarian seeks magical works for the collection on mummies and the unsavory undead. Your contribution helps expand the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: The library’s collection depends on works brought by visitors. You are asked to add something about mummies and the unsavory undead, and further magical books may also be of use. Each such work can widen what the library knows.

faq.answer: The librarian seeks works about mummies and the unsavory undead, along with other magical books that could benefit the library.

faq.q: Why bring a book to the library?
faq.answer: Works brought to the librarian expand the library’s knowledge.

faq.q: Can I bring other magical books?
faq.answer: Yes. The librarian welcomes other magical works that might benefit the library.
